translation: Roasted (燔之), it treats children's diarrhea and dysentery, intestinal rumbling, and fright-epilepsy (驚癇). The original text of the Benjing: [blank] yangjiao (羊角), salty in flavor, warm. It treats green blindness with brightened eyes, kills scab mites (疥蟲), stops cold diarrhea (寒泄), and wards off evil ghosts, tigers and wolves, and stops fright-palpitation (驚悸).
